post.description:
Open a merchant account. The API key in the answer is shown once; Landfall keeps only its hash.
Closed by default: a deployment opens sign-up with LANDFALL_ALLOW_SIGNUP=1 (local runs and tests do). The hosted demo has one merchant, Kiln & Co.

Read the store's public product feed (Shopify-style /products.json) into this merchant's catalogue, one product per SKU. No model call here:
recommendations are requested per product afterwards.
Re-read the saved feed now (the nightly job does the same for every shop). New products get a recommendation; changed listings must be reviewed again.

schema.title: Response Assistant History Api Products  Product Id  Assistant Get

post.description: Ask about this product's recommendation. The assistant explains and points to sources; it has no path to Accept or Override.
The duty for a cart and a destination, from the register: no model call. With the merchant's API key the items may be named by SKU.
Create the PayPal order with the duty as tax_total and per-item tax. Returns the PayPal approval link for the buyer.

Before capturing, the merchant's server sends the PayPal order the buyer approved and the quote's token. Valid means the order carries exactly the quoted
duty, totals, currency and items. Nothing here touches PayPal or any PayPal credential.

get.description: What Landfall covers and where each source comes from (public; no seller data).

schema.title: Response Ops Rules Api Ops Rules Get

refused.title: Refused
refused.description: True when the assistant declined (asked to decide, to pay less than is due, or off topic). It never decides for the seller.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: product_id and reason; only the High band is bulk-acceptable

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: The destination ids this origin is covered for

feed_url.title: Feed Url
feed_url.description: The store's public product feed, for example https://shop.example/products.json

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of the feed's plain prices (feeds that carry presentment prices bring their own)

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO-2 country the shop ships from

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Shown once. Landfall keeps only a hash of it.

publishable_key.title: Publishable Key
publishable_key.description: Quote-only and safe to put in a web page: the checkout widget sends it. It cannot import, order or read anything.

paypal_purchase_unit.title: Paypal Purchase Unit
paypal_purchase_unit.description: The purchase unit Landfall sent to PayPal: amount.breakdown.tax_total and the per-item tax. Shown so a merchant can see where the duty lands.

label_text.title: Label Text
label_text.description: Text printed on the product's own label, tag or packaging

made_in.title: Made In
made_in.description: A country named as the place of manufacture

error.title: Error
error.description: Why this photo could not be read, in plain words

sku.title: Sku
sku.description: The merchant's own SKU, so its checkout can name the product the way its store does

code.title: Code
code.description: Accepted or recommended code, as displayed

listing_changed.title: Listing Changed
listing_changed.description: The store changed this listing after the seller's decision: review again. Until then it is not priced duty-paid

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: Up to four photo addresses (https). The AI reads them once for labels, a made-in country and visible materials; Landfall keeps the addresses and the text read, never the image

price_impact.description: Change to what the buyer pays if chosen

seller_discount.description: Duty the seller covers (Absorb it on Rule Radar). The duty stays in tax_total in full; this is a separate seller-funded discount.

paused_reason.title: Paused Reason
paused_reason.description: 7 days without a good sync: duties-included paused

paypal_purchase_unit.title: Paypal Purchase Unit
paypal_purchase_unit.description: The PayPal purchase unit for this cart: amount with its breakdown (tax_total) and the items with their tax, exact to the cent. A merchant with its own PayPal integration puts it into its own create-order call.

quote_token.title: Quote Token
quote_token.description: Signed by Landfall. The merchant's server sends it to /api/quotes/verify with the PayPal order before capturing.

quote_expires_at.title: Quote Expires At
quote_expires_at.description: Unix seconds. After this the quote must be asked for again.

shop_id.title: Shop Id
shop_id.description: Only for the keyless demo shop. With an API key the shop is the key's own.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Optional when ship_to_country is given: the country decides it

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Optional: it is the destination's currency. If given it must match: Landfall never converts.

ship_to_country.title: Ship To Country
ship_to_country.description: ISO-2 ship-to country; with it the destination, member state or province follow

region.title: Region
region.description: Canadian province code (the EU member state goes in eu_member_state)

sku.title: Sku
sku.description: The merchant's own SKU (needs the merchant's API key)

unpriced_reason.title: Unpriced Reason
unpriced_reason.description: Plain reason this line carries no duty (not reviewed, not priced, outside what Landfall prices)

paypal_order.title: Paypal Order
paypal_order.description: The order as PayPal returns it (GET /v2/checkout/orders/{id}), fetched with the merchant's own credentials

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Plain reasons when the order does not match the quote; empty when it does

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Sentence the value came from. Blank field if the model found none.

code.title: Code
code.description: Code for the primary destination as displayed, e.g. 6912.00.44.00

headline.title: Headline
examples: No questions needed: both likely codes cost the same

help_terms.title: Help Terms
help_terms.description: Search words taken from the listing, already filled into the help links

help_links.title: Help Links
help_links.description: Official places to look the code up; empty for goods Landfall will not price for legal, safety or moral reasons

help_prominent.title: Help Prominent
help_prominent.description: True when Landfall found no code or is not confident: the links lead the page

photo_reads.title: Photo Reads
photo_reads.description: What the AI read in the product's photos (text only: the photos are not kept)

duties_included.title: Duties Included
duties_included.description: True when the seller has accepted a code and origin: the buyer pays duty in the price

note.title: Note
note.description: Plain reason when duties are not included

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: True for goods Landfall will not handle for legal, safety or moral reasons: they cannot be added to a cart

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: Title or description changed in the feed: the earlier decision no longer applies until the seller reviews again

removed.title: Removed
removed.description: No longer in the feed: not sold through the checkout

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.description: New or changed products that now have a recommendation waiting for the seller

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: New or changed products left without a recommendation (the recommender was unavailable)
